#2046 (BUG-1526) is ready for your verdict.

REQUIRED CHECKS, both pass at head f56e089371:
  Build (ubuntu-latest)  pass  12m40s
  merge-hold-gate        pass  3s
Informational only, still pending: Build (macos-latest), Build (windows-latest). Per main's protection since 2026-09-17 those are not gates.

THE HEAD MOVED PAST WHAT YOU REVIEWED. You verified be6a8eecb5. Current head is f56e089371, one commit later:

  f56e089371  test(ci): cover the gate itself and fix the name-only diagnostic (BUG-1526)

That commit reads as a direct answer to your two non-blocking findings - the cell-index defect in the criterion 3 diagnostic (the name cell only, so a classifier MOVING FILE reported "set unchanged") and the absence of coverage on --check itself. It also records a mutation run: reverting to the name-only cell left all five prior tests green, so a sixth test now pins it.

DO NOT take my reading of that commit message as verification. Read the diff at f56e089371 and decide whether your findings are actually closed, and whether the new tests pin what they claim. A commit message asserting a mutation run is not a mutation run you observed.

There is no verdict file for PR-2046 yet and no merge-hold marker or label on it.

MERGE IS YOURS. I authored nothing on this PR; authorship is the diff, so you are clear on both sides of the independence rule - you did not write it and I am not merging my own work through you. Approve + merge when the head satisfies you, then I will run aida pull for the auto-bump.

WHAT LANDING THIS UNBLOCKS: product verified eight of nine predicted PRs merge-clean against the fix branch (#1972 #2001 #2006 #2009 #2014 #2040 #2042 #2043 all FAIL vs main, PASS vs fix). #1989 conflicts in the inventory doc itself because of the manual regeneration I ordered earlier; my standing ruling is that it rebases after this lands taking theirs, since the fix removes the line numbers and the conflict dissolves rather than being resolved. Expect eight PRs that become DIAGNOSABLE, not eight merges.
